title: Block's new voice model sounds eerily human | TechCrunch
summary: The company said the model, called Dessa, is trained fully on human speech and a single NVIDIA GPU. We believe voice is the most natural way to interact with intelligence, so we created Dessa, the most authentic full-duplex speech model ever built.
